description.name: PaymentHooks
description.long: Connects WHMCS to PaymentHooks. PaymentHooks hosts the checkout, routes each payment to your connected gateway, and runs subscriptions and refunds. This module creates hosted checkout sessions, redirects the client to pay, and reconciles invoices from signed webhooks.
features: Hosted redirect checkout, optionally on your custom domain
One-time payments with full and partial refunds
Recurring billing driven by PaymentHooks subscriptions
Signed webhook reconciliation, each event applied once
Test and live through your PaymentHooks Platform Mode
